messages.author: fcf931fd673ef552
messages.subject: RStan Compilation error when there is indexing in generated quantities
parts:
Hi, 

I recently update to RStan 2.12.1 on a Windows 10 machine, with R-studio 1.0.44, R 3.3.2(64bit) and Rtools 3.3.x.
While trying to run models I successfully ran with stan 2.10 and 2.11 I got compilation error and a warning.
I recreate the error with the following logistic regression example:

model <- "
data{
  int N;
  int t;
  
  matrix[N,t] covMat;
  int y[N];
}
parameters{
vector[t] beta;
}
transformed parameters{
vector[N] xb;
xb = covMat*beta;
}
model{
y ~ bernoulli_logit(xb);
}
generated quantities{
vector[t] ew;
ew=exp(beta);
}
"
stm <- stan_model(model_code=model)

Error in compileCode(f, code, language = language, verbose = verbose) : 
  Compilation ERROR, function(s)/method(s) not created! Cannot export (default: symbol not defined
Cannot export 64): symbol not defined
Cannot export ANOMALY:: symbol not defined
Cannot export _ZZNK4stan11variational4adviIN60model346070b25b45_1b5d78b7f9957512a23992987098710a_namespace50model346070b25b45_1b5d78b7f9957512a23992987098710aENS0_16normal_meanfieldEN5boost6random23additive_combine_engineINS6_26linear_congruential_engineIjLj40014ELj0ELj2147483563EEENS8_IjLj40692ELj0ELj2147483399EEEEEE9calc_ELBOERKS4_R[0x7FF81DDF70E3]: symbol not defined
Cannot export is: symbol not defined
Cannot export meaningless: symbol not defined
Cannot export of: symbol not defined
Cannot export operand: symbol not defined
Cannot export size: symbol not defined
Cannot export use: symbol not defined
collect2.exe: error: ld returned 1 exit status
In addition: Warning message:
In if (nchar(CXX) > 0) return(TRUE) :
  the condition has length > 1 and only the first element will be used

I am getting the warning(in yellow) for all stan models. 
The error is a new one. I noticed that when I change the indexing to a numerical value (e.g: 3) there is no error in compilation. But the warning appears.

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: RStan Compilation error when there is indexing in generated quantities

Finally after much investigation, I found where is the issue. 
Apparently, there is an incompatibility between Rstan and Trend Micro Internet Security. 
When I disabled the antivirus software, the error and the warning message are gone. 

Thank you very much to all respondents. Helped me a lot to figure out the issue fast. 

Shall I change this post to complete?

Best regards
Sreenath Madathil
